notes: The next version of an encrypted folder's key, after someone lost the folder (todo.rekey in GET /api/keys): made on the device of an admin who holds the newest version and the root, signed by the root (share-e2ee-v1/sign/folder-key), sealed for them and for the recovery key. New uploads seal their file keys for it; older files keep theirs. Errors: 409 key_outdated unless version is the next one, 409 not_encrypted for a folder switched off (turning it on makes the next version), 400 bad_signature, 404 not_found for a folder the caller holds no newest key of.
